window.nvNetRoads = function (roads, parsePath, bboxOf) {
  const D = window.NV_DATA, C = D.NET_CIRC || {}, out = [];
  for (const r of roads) {
    r.p = new Path2D(); for (const p of r.polys) p.forEach((q, i) => i ? r.p.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : r.p.moveTo(q[0], q[1]));
    r.bb = bboxOf(r.polys, 20); r.caps = [];
    const c = C[r.name];
    if (c && r.polys.length === 1 && r.polys[0].length > 40) {
      const [cx, cy, rad] = c; r.circle = [cx, cy, rad];
      const ring = []; for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) { const a = i / 64 * Math.PI * 2; ring.push([cx + Math.cos(a) * rad, cy + Math.sin(a) * rad]) }
      const P2 = new Path2D(); P2.arc(cx, cy, rad - 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      out.push({ x0: cx - rad, y0: cy - rad, x1: cx + rad, y1: cy + rad, ring, P: P2, road: r, circ: true });
    }
  }
  return out;
};
window.nvDrawNet = function (ctx, K, P, FLAT, rv, SUN) {
  const N = window.NV_NETPOLY;
  if (!N._p) { N._p = {}; for (const L in N) { if (L[0] === '_') continue; N._p[L] = {}; for (const g in N[L]) N._p[L][g] = new Path2D(N[L][g]) } }
  const COL = { minor: [P.minorCase, P.minor], road: [P.roadCase, P.road], hw: [P.hwCase, P.hw],
                gravel: [FLAT ? '#e4dccd' : '#b49a70', FLAT ? '#f3eee4' : '#dcc69b'] };
  const ORDER = ['gravel', 'minor', 'road', 'hw'], cw = 2.2 * Math.max(K, .6);
  ctx.save(); ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  // highway drop shadow
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(SUN[0] * 5, SUN[1] * 5); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(60,36,24,.22)';
  for (const L in N._p) if (N._p[L].hw) ctx.fill(N._p[L].hw); ctx.restore();
  const layers = Object.keys(N._p).sort();
  for (const L of layers) {
    const g = N._p[L], bridge = L !== '0';
    for (const k of ORDER) if (g[k]) { ctx.fillStyle = ctx.strokeStyle = COL[k][0]; ctx.lineWidth = cw * (k === 'hw' ? 1.35 : 1) * (bridge ? 1.3 : 1); ctx.stroke(g[k]); ctx.fill(g[k]) }
    for (const k of ORDER) if (g[k]) { ctx.fillStyle = ctx.strokeStyle = COL[k][1]; ctx.lineWidth = .5; ctx.fill(g[k]); ctx.stroke(g[k]) }
    if (bridge && N._p['0'] && N._p['0'].hw) { const h = N._p['0'].hw; ctx.fillStyle = ctx.strokeStyle = COL.hw[1]; ctx.lineWidth = .5; ctx.fill(h); ctx.stroke(h) }
  }
  // highway centre dashes
  ctx.lineCap = 'butt'; ctx.strokeStyle = P.hwLine; ctx.lineWidth = 1.1 * K; ctx.setLineDash([9, 8]);
  for (const r of rv) if (r.k === 'hw') ctx.stroke(r.p);
  ctx.setLineDash([]); ctx.restore();
};
</script>

 for(let i=0;i<poly.length-1;i++){const [ax,ay]=poly[i],[bx,by]=poly[i+1],l=Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay);for(let d=0;d<l;d+=9){rs.push([ax+(bx-ax)*d/l,ay+(by-ay)*d/l,acc+d,-(by-ay)/l,(bx-ax)/l])}acc+=l}

 const CIRC=[];for(const r of roads){if(!/Circle|Ouroboros|Roundabout/.test(r.name))continue;const pts=r.polys.flat();const cx=pts.reduce((q,p)=>q+p[0],0)/pts.length,cy=pts.reduce((q,p)=>q+p[1],0)/pts.length,rad=pts.reduce((q,p)=>q+Math.hypot(p[0]-cx,p[1]-cy),0)/pts.length;const ring=[];for(let i=0;i<=64;i++){const a=i/64*Math.PI*2;ring.push([cx+Math.cos(a)*rad,cy+Math.sin(a)*rad])}r.polys=[ring];r.circle=[cx,cy,rad];
  const ri=rad-1,cr=[];for(let i=0;i<64;i++){const a=i/64*Math.PI*2;cr.push([cx+Math.cos(a)*rad,cy+Math.sin(a)*rad])}const P2=new Path2D();P2.arc(cx,cy,ri,0,Math.PI*2);CIRC.push({x0:cx-ri,y0:cy-ri,x1:cx+ri,y1:cy+ri,ring:cr,P:P2,road:r})}
 // clusters

 let merged=true;while(merged){merged=false;for(let i=0;i<CL.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<CL.length;j++){const A=CL[i],B=CL[j];const ox=Math.min(A.x1,B.x1)-Math.max(A.x0,B.x0),oy=Math.min(A.y1,B.y1)-Math.max(A.y0,B.y0),mn=Math.min((A.x1-A.x0)*(A.y1-A.y0),(B.x1-B.x0)*(B.y1-B.y0));if(ox>0&&oy>0&&ox*oy>mn*.3){A.x0=Math.min(A.x0,B.x0);A.y0=Math.min(A.y0,B.y0);A.x1=Math.max(A.x1,B.x1);A.y1=Math.max(A.y1,B.y1);A.types.push(...B.types);CL.splice(j,1);merged=true;j--}}}
 for(const c of CL){const w=c.x1-c.x0,h=c.y1-c.y0,rad=Math.min(16,w/4,h/4),pts=[],x0=c.x0,y0=c.y0;
  const line=(ax,ay,bx,by)=>{const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay)/4));for(let k=0;k<n;k++)pts.push([ax+(bx-ax)*k/n,ay+(by-ay)*k/n])},arc=(cx,cy,a0)=>{for(let k=0;k<6;k++){const a=a0+k/6*Math.PI/2;pts.push([cx+Math.cos(a)*rad,cy+Math.sin(a)*rad])}};

 for(const r of roads){r.caps=[];if((r.k==='hw'||r.k==='ramp')||r.circle)continue;for(const p of r.polys){if(p.length<2)continue;for(const end of[1,0]){const e=end?p[p.length-1]:p[0];if(!inB(e)||conn(e,p))continue;

 {const CI=roads.filter(r=>r.circle).map(r=>r.circle);for(const r of roads){if(r.circle||r.k==='hw'||r.k==='ramp')continue;for(const p of r.polys){for(const end of[1,0]){const e=end?p[p.length-1]:p[0];for(const [cx,cy,rad] of CI){const d=Math.hypot(e[0]-cx,e[1]-cy);if(d<rad+RW[r.k]+8&&d>rad*.4){const pr=end?p[p.length-2]:p[1];if(!pr)break;const ux=e[0]-pr[0],uy=e[1]-pr[1],ul=Math.hypot(ux,uy)||1,vx=cx-e[0],vy=cy-e[1],vl=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1;if((ux*vx+uy*vy)/(ul*vl)>.7||d<rad-2){if(end)p.push([cx,cy]);else p.unshift([cx,cy])}break}}}}}}

function build(){

function buildLM(L,F){const P=DAY,{x,y,w,h,type:t}=L,x0=x-w/2,y0=y-h/2,bb={x:x0-20,y:y0-20,w:w+40,h:h+40},G=F.ground;
 const B=o=>F.addB(Object.assign({tx:1,ty:0,h:5,lm:true},o));
 const pave=(c)=>(g,K)=>{rrect(g,x0,y0,w,h,3);g.fillStyle=c||P.pave;g.fill();g.strokeStyle=P.paveLine;g.lineWidth=.7*K;g.stroke()};
 const stalls=(px,py,pw,ph)=>(g,K)=>{g.fillStyle=P.asphalt;g.fillRect(px,py,pw,ph);g.strokeStyle=P.asphaltLine;g.lineWidth=.45*K;g.beginPath();for(let yy=py+1.5;yy<py+ph-3;yy+=8.5)for(let xx=px+2;xx<px+pw-1;xx+=3){g.moveTo(xx,yy);g.lineTo(xx,yy+3.2)}g.stroke()};
 const draw=(...fs)=>G.push({bb,draw:(g,K)=>fs.forEach(f=>f(g,K))});
 const cars=(n,px,py,pw)=>{for(let k=0;k<n;k++)B({x:px+(k+.5)*pw/n,y:py,w:2.1,d:3.6,type:'car',c:[['#e9e6df','#c9473b'],['#e9e6df','#3f6b9c'],['#e9e6df','#e2e0da'],['#e9e6df','#2f3136']][k%4],h:1})};

function football(g,cx,cy,len,wid,ang,K){const P=DAY;g.save();g.translate(cx,cy);g.rotate(ang);const hl=len/2,hw=wid/2,ez=len*.083;

 g.lineWidth=.3*K;g.beginPath();for(let k=0;k<50;k++){const x=-hl+ez+(len-2*ez)*k/50;g.moveTo(x,-hw*.35);g.lineTo(x,-hw*.28);g.moveTo(x,hw*.28);g.lineTo(x,hw*.35)}g.stroke();
 g.strokeStyle='#f1d34a';g.lineWidth=.6*K;g.beginPath();for(const sg of[-1,1]){g.moveTo(sg*(hl+.4),-hw*.22);g.lineTo(sg*(hl+.4),hw*.22);g.moveTo(sg*(hl+.4),0);g.lineTo(sg*(hl+2),0)}g.stroke();

function diamond(g,hx,hy,Rd,ang,K){const P=DAY;g.save();g.translate(hx,hy);g.rotate(ang);const b=Rd*.33;
 g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,0);g.arc(0,0,Rd,-Math.PI/4,Math.PI/4);g.closePath();g.fillStyle=P.grass;g.fill();g.strokeStyle=P.track;g.lineWidth=Rd*.05;g.beginPath();g.arc(0,0,Rd*.97,-Math.PI/4,Math.PI/4);g.stroke();

 const c=Math.SQRT1_2*b*.8;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(b*.12,0);g.lineTo(c+b*.06,c);g.lineTo(b*.8*Math.SQRT2,0);g.lineTo(c+b*.06,-c);g.closePath();g.fillStyle=P.grass2;g.fill();

 g.strokeStyle='#fff';g.lineWidth=.45*K;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,0);g.lineTo(Rd*Math.SQRT1_2,Rd*Math.SQRT1_2);g.moveTo(0,0);g.lineTo(Rd*Math.SQRT1_2,-Rd*Math.SQRT1_2);g.stroke();
 g.fillStyle='#fff';for(const [x,y] of [[b*Math.SQRT1_2,b*Math.SQRT1_2],[b*Math.SQRT2,0],[b*Math.SQRT1_2,-b*Math.SQRT1_2],[0,0]])g.fillRect(x-1,y-1,2,2);

// ---------- labels ----------
function mkLabels(roads,areas){const CIRL=roads.filter(r=>r.circle).map(r=>r.circle);
 const L={regions:[],districts:[],areas:[],pois:[],streets:[],beyond:[]};
 const fix={'Radon Canyon':[2560,1900],'Sand Wastes':[640,1735],'Scrub Lands':[1500,2160],'Whispering Forest':[2860,700],'Western Ridge':[230,200],'Night Vale Lake':[30,1760],'Western Ridge':[70,260]};
 for(const r of D.RG){const p=fix[r.n]||[r.x,r.y];L.regions.push({t:r.t,x:p[0],y:p[1]})}
 for(const d of D.D)L.districts.push({t:d.t,x:d.x,y:d.y});
 for(const a of areas)L.areas.push({t:SHORT[a.name]||a.name,name:a.name,x:a.x,y:a.y,w:a.w,h:a.h});
 const skip=new Set([...areas.map(a=>a.name),...D.RG.map(r=>r.n),...D.D.map(d=>d.n),'Industrial District','Old Landfill','New Landfill']);
 for(const it of D.I){const [n,c,x,y,imp,fl]=it;if(c==='R'||c==='D'||skip.has(n))continue;if(c==='E')continue;L.pois.push({t:SHORT[n]||n,name:n,x,y,major:fl.includes('m'),imp:imp||0,cat:c})}
 L.pois.sort((a,b)=>(b.major-a.major)||(b.imp-a.imp));
 for(const r of roads){if(!r.name)continue;const segs=[];for(const p of r.polys){let acc=[p[0]],len=0;for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++){const dx=p[i][0]-p[i-1][0],dy=p[i][1]-p[i-1][1];len+=Math.hypot(dx,dy)}
   for(let i=0;i<p.length-1;i++){const [ax,ay]=p[i],[bx,by]=p[i+1];if(CIRL.some(([cx,cy,rad])=>Math.hypot((ax+bx)/2-cx,(ay+by)/2-cy)<rad+6||Math.hypot(bx-cx,by-cy)<rad*.5||Math.hypot(ax-cx,ay-cy)<rad*.5))continue;segs.push({ax,ay,bx,by,len:Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay)})}}
  // merge nearly collinear consecutive segments
  const mg=[];for(const s of segs){const l=mg[mg.length-1];if(l&&Math.abs(l.bx-s.ax)<.5&&Math.abs(l.by-s.ay)<.5){const a1=Math.atan2(l.by-l.ay,l.bx-l.ax),a2=Math.atan2(s.by-s.ay,s.bx-s.ax);if(Math.abs(a1-a2)<.12){l.bx=s.bx;l.by=s.by;l.len=Math.hypot(l.bx-l.ax,l.by-l.ay);continue}}mg.push({...s})}
  L.streets.push({t:r.name==='Somerset / Summerset'?'Somerset':r.name,k:r.k,segs:mg.filter(s=>s.len>30)})}
 return L}

// ---------- sprites ----------
const SPR=new Map();
function treePath(g,r,kind,v){const Rn=mul(v*977+kind.length*31);g.beginPath();
 if(kind==='spike'||kind==='shrub'){const n=kind==='shrub'?9:12+(v%3);for(let i=0;i<n*2;i++){const a=i/(n*2)*Math.PI*2+v,rad=i%2?r*(kind==='shrub'?.62:.74):r*(.94+Rn()*.1);const x=Math.cos(a)*rad,y=Math.sin(a)*rad;i?g.lineTo(x,y):g.moveTo(x,y)}g.closePath()}
 else if(kind==='cactus'||kind==='hood'){g.arc(0,0,r*.9,0,Math.PI*2)}
 else{const n=7+(v%3);let a0=v;for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const a=a0+i/n*Math.PI*2,rad=r*(.8+Rn()*.08);const x=Math.cos(a)*rad,y=Math.sin(a)*rad;if(!i){g.moveTo(x,y);continue}const am=a-Math.PI/n,cr=r*1.16;g.quadraticCurveTo(Math.cos(am)*cr,Math.sin(am)*cr,x,y)}g.closePath()}}
function sprite(kind,pal,v,rpx){const key=kind+pal+'|'+v+'|'+rpx;let c=SPR.get(key);if(c)return c;const pad=3,sz=Math.ceil(rpx*2.4+pad*2);c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=sz;const g=c.getContext('2d'),TA=TREEPAL[kind],[base,hi,dk]=TA[pal%TA.length];g.translate(sz/2,sz/2);const lw=clamp(rpx*.1,.55,2.2);if(STY.flat){g.beginPath();g.arc(0,0,rpx*.9,0,7);g.fillStyle=base;g.fill();g.save();g.clip();g.beginPath();g.arc(-rpx*.28,-rpx*.32,rpx*.62,0,7);g.fillStyle=hi;g.fill();g.restore();SPR.set(key,c);return c}
 treePath(g,rpx,kind,v);g.fillStyle=base;g.fill();g.save();g.clip();g.beginPath();g.arc(-rpx*.3,-rpx*.34,rpx*.72,0,7);g.fillStyle=hi;g.fill();g.beginPath();g.arc(rpx*.45,rpx*.5,rpx*.62,0,7);g.fillStyle=dk;g.globalAlpha=.45;g.fill();g.globalAlpha=1;
 if(kind==='cactus'){g.strokeStyle=dk;g.lineWidth=lw*.8;g.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const a=i/8*Math.PI*2;g.moveTo(0,0);g.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*rpx,Math.sin(a)*rpx)}g.stroke()}
 g.restore();
 if(rpx>4&&(kind==='puff'||kind==='spike')){g.strokeStyle=DAY.tink;g.globalAlpha=.55;g.lineWidth=lw*.8;g.beginPath();g.arc(rpx*.05,rpx*.02,rpx*.32,.25*Math.PI,.8*Math.PI);g.stroke();g.globalAlpha=1}
 if(kind==='hood'){g.fillStyle='#7d6f99';g.beginPath();g.arc(-rpx*.15,-rpx*.2,rpx*.32,0,7);g.fill()}
 treePath(g,rpx,kind,v);g.strokeStyle=DAY.tink;g.lineWidth=lw;g.stroke();SPR.set(key,c);return c}
const GLC={};function glowC(c0,c1){const k=c0+c1;if(GLC[k])return GLC[k];const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=64;const g=c.getContext('2d'),gr=g.createRadialGradient(32,32,0,32,32,32);gr.addColorStop(0,c0);gr.addColorStop(.3,c1);gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,64,64);return GLC[k]=c}
let GLOW=null;function glow(){if(GLOW)return GLOW;const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=64;const g=c.getContext('2d'),gr=g.createRadialGradient(32,32,0,32,32,32);gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,214,140,.95)');gr.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(255,190,110,.45)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,170,90,0)');g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,64,64);return GLOW=c}
let GRAIN=null;function grain(){if(GRAIN)return GRAIN;const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=160;const g=c.getContext('2d'),Rn=mul(99);for(let i=0;i<2600;i++){g.fillStyle=Rn()<.5?'rgba(120,85,50,.16)':'rgba(255,250,235,.22)';g.fillRect(Rn()*160,Rn()*160,1+Rn()*1.4,1+Rn()*1.4)}return GRAIN=c}

// ---------- scene ----------
function soft(g,path,color,blur,s){g.save();g.shadowColor=color;g.shadowBlur=blur*s;g.shadowOffsetX=20000*1;g.translate(-20000/s,0);g.fillStyle=color;g.fill(path);g.restore()}
const VMC=new Map();function VM(c){if(!STY.vale||typeof c!=='string')return c;let v=VMC.get(c);if(v!==undefined)return v;let r,g,b,a=1,m;if((m=/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(c))){const n=parseInt(m[1],16);r=n>>16;g=(n>>8)&255;b=n&255}else if((m=/^#([0-9a-f]{3})$/i.exec(c))){r=parseInt(m[1][0]+m[1][0],16);g=parseInt(m[1][1]+m[1][1],16);b=parseInt(m[1][2]+m[1][2],16)}else if((m=/^rgba?\(([^)]+)\)$/i.exec(c))){const p=m[1].split(',').map(x=>parseFloat(x));[r,g,b]=p;a=p.length>3?p[3]:1}else{VMC.set(c,c);return c}
 r/=255;g/=255;b/=255;const mx=Math.max(r,g,b),mn=Math.min(r,g,b);let h=0,sa=0,l=(mx+mn)/2;if(mx!==mn){const d=mx-mn;sa=l>.5?d/(2-mx-mn):d/(mx+mn);h=mx===r?(g-b)/d+(g<b?6:0):mx===g?(b-r)/d+2:(r-g)/d+4;h*=60}
 const warm=h>=15&&h<=75&&sa>.08;if(a<.5||(l<=.55&&!(warm&&l>.18))){v=c}else{const L=l>.55?.1+(1-l)*.55:l*.62;let H=h,S=sa;if(warm){H=284+(h-45)*.35;S=Math.min(.42,.18+sa*.35)}else if(sa<.3){H=282;S=.3}else S=Math.min(.6,sa*.75);const q=L<.5?L*(1+S):L+S-L*S,p2=2*L-q,f=t=>{t=(t%360+360)%360/360;const tt=t<1/6?p2+(q-p2)*6*t:t<.5?q:t<2/3?p2+(q-p2)*(2/3-t)*6:p2;return Math.round(tt*255)};v=a<1?'rgba('+f(H+120)+','+f(H)+','+f(H-120)+','+a+')':'rgb('+f(H+120)+','+f(H)+','+f(H-120)+')'}
 VMC.set(c,v);return v}
function vmWrap(ctx){if(ctx.__vm)return;const pr=Object.getPrototypeOf(ctx),fd=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(pr,'fillStyle'),sd=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(pr,'strokeStyle');if(!fd||!sd)return;Object.defineProperty(ctx,'fillStyle',{get(){return fd.get.call(this)},set(x){fd.set.call(this,VM(x))},configurable:true});Object.defineProperty(ctx,'strokeStyle',{get(){return sd.get.call(this)},set(x){sd.set.call(this,VM(x))},configurable:true});ctx.__vm=1}
function render(ctx,sctx,s,vl,vt,vw,vh,night){vmWrap(ctx);
 const P=DAY,w=build(),K=clamp(Math.pow(s,-.5),.32,1.3),V={x:vl-60,y:vt-60,x2:vl+vw+60,y2:vt+vh+60};
 const vis=b=>!(b.x>V.x2||b.y>V.y2||b.x+b.w<V.x||b.y+b.h<V.y);
 const cw=ctx.canvas.width,ch=ctx.canvas.height;
 const setW=g=>g.setTransform(s,0,0,s,-vl*s,-vt*s);
 ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.fillStyle=P.ground;ctx.fillRect(0,0,cw,ch);setW(ctx);
 // grain
 const FLAT=!!STY.flat;if(!FLAT){const pat=ctx.createPattern(grain(),'repeat');ctx.fillStyle=pat;ctx.fillRect(V.x,V.y,V.x2-V.x,V.y2-V.y)}
 // hills contours
 ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.strokeStyle=P.contour;ctx.lineWidth=1.3*K;ctx.setLineDash([.01,4.2*Math.max(K,.6)]);
 if(!FLAT)for(const hl of w.hills){if(!vis({x:hl.x-hl.rad,y:hl.y-hl.rad,w:hl.rad*2,h:hl.rad*2}))continue;for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const rad=hl.rad*(1-k*.22);ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<=64;i++){const a=i/64*Math.PI*2,rv=rad*(1+.12*Math.sin(3*a+hl.ph+k*.3)+.07*Math.sin(5*a+hl.ph2));const x=hl.x+Math.cos(a)*rv*1.3,y=hl.y+Math.sin(a)*rv*.8;i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y)}ctx.stroke()}}
 ctx.setLineDash([]);

'+o.first;return `<button class="nv-result" type="button" data-name="${E(o.name)}" aria-current="${String(selected&&selected.name===o.name)}"><span class="nv-result-icon">${icon(o)}</span><span class="nv-result-text"><div class="nv-result-name">${E(o.name)}</div><div class="nv-result-sub">${E(sub)}</div></span></button>`}).join('')+(items.length>limit?`<button class="nv-result" type="button" data-more="1" style="justify-content:center;color:#915c3b;font-weight:700">Show more results (${items.length-visible.length})</button>`:'');}
function short(t,n=280){t=String(t||'').trim();return t.length<=n?t:t.slice(0,n).replace(/\s+\S*$/,'')+'…'}
function renderDetail(o){selected=o;detail.classList.remove('nv-expanded');let html=`<button type="button" id="nv-sheet-toggle" class="nv-sheet-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Expand place details"><span class="nv-sheet-grip"></span><span class="nv-sheet-label">Swipe up for details</span><span class="nv-sheet-chevron">⌃</span></button><div class="nv-detail-top"><div class="nv-detail-kind">${E(KIND[typ(o)]||'Location')}</div><button type="button" id="nv-detail-close" class="nv-iconbtn" aria-label="Close location details" title="Close">✕</button></div><h2>${E(o.name)}</h2><div class="nv-detail-sub">${E(o.type||KIND[typ(o)]||'Location')}${o.district?' · '+E(o.district):''}</div><div class="nv-more-content">`;
 if(o.aliases&&o.aliases.length)html+=`<p class="nv-detail-note">Also known as ${o.aliases.slice(0,5).map(E).join(', ')}.</p>`;
 if(o.note)html+=`<p class="nv-detail-note">${E(o.note)}</p>`;
 if(o.unplaced)html+='<p class="nv-detail-note"><strong>Not plotted:</strong> No defensible precise location appears in the available sources.</p>';if(o.kind==='road')html+='<p class="nv-detail-note">Street alignment is an interpretive reconstruction from the transcripts.</p>';
 if(o.kind==='district')html+='<p class="nv-detail-note">The district outline is inferred from named places and geographical clues.</p>';
 const st=String(o.status||'');if(/unsourced/i.test(st))html+=`<div class="nv-detail-sub">No transcript source found</div>`;else if(/infer|schematic|low|medium/i.test(st))html+=`<div class="nv-detail-sub">Placement: ${E(st)}</div>`;
 const rel=(meta.verified&&meta.verified[o.name])||[];
 if(rel.length)html+=`<section class="nv-section"><h3>Geographic clues</h3>${rel.map(r=>`<p class="nv-relation"><b>${E(r[0])}</b> · ${E(r[1])}${r[2]?' (Ep. '+E(r[2])+')':''}</p>`).join('')}</section>`;
 if(o.episodes&&o.episodes.length)html+=`<section class="nv-section"><h3>Transcript appearances</h3><div class="nv-tag-list">${o.episodes.slice(0,16).map(ep=>`<span class="nv-ep-tag">EP ${E(ep)}</span>`).join('')}</div></section>`;
 if(o.excerpt&&o.excerpt.length)html+=`<section class="nv-section"><h3>Transcript excerpts</h3>${o.excerpt.slice(0,3).map(x=>`<div class="nv-source"><small>EP ${E(x.episode)}${x.title?' · '+E(x.title):''}</small><p>${E(short(x.text))}</p></div>`).join('')}</section>`;
 if(o.source&&/^https?:\/\//.test(o.source))html+=`<a class="nv-link" href="${E(o.source)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Read cited transcript ↗</a>`;
 html+='<div class="nv-detail-actions">'+(!o.unplaced&&Number.isFinite(Number(o.x))&&Number.isFinite(Number(o.y))?'<button id="nv-focus-place" type="button" class="nv-action">Locate on map</button>':'<span class="nv-unplaced-label">Location intentionally unplotted</span>')+'<button type="button" id="nv-clear-place" class="nv-action alt">Clear selection</button></div>';
 html+='</div>';detail.innerHTML=html;detail.classList.add('nv-open');detail.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');document.body.classList.add('nv-selected');detail.scrollTop=0;renderList();
 detail.querySelector('#nv-detail-close').onclick=closeDetails;detail.querySelector('#nv-clear-place').onclick=closeDetails;const locate=detail.querySelector('#nv-focus-place');if(locate)locate.onclick=()=>focusPlace(o,true);
 const sheetButton=detail.querySelector('#nv-sheet-toggle');sheetButton.onclick=()=>toggleSheet();
 const heading=detail.querySelector('h2');heading.style.cursor=innerWidth<=760?'pointer':'';heading.onclick=()=>{if(innerWidth<=760)toggleSheet()};

}
function toggleSheet(force){if(innerWidth>760||!detail.classList.contains('nv-open'))return;const expand=force==null?!detail.classList.contains('nv-expanded'):!!force;
 detail.classList.toggle('nv-expanded',expand);const b=detail.querySelector('#nv-sheet-toggle');if(b){b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(expand));b.setAttribute('aria-label',expand?'Collapse place details':'Expand place details');const t=b.querySelector('.nv-sheet-label');if(t)t.textContent=expand?'Swipe down to minimize':'Swipe up for details';}detail.scrollTop=0;}
let sheetY=null,sheetX=0;
detail.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{if(innerWidth>760||!e.touches.length)return;sheetY=e.touches[0].clientY;sheetX=e.touches[0].clientX},{passive:true});
detail.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(innerWidth>760||sheetY==null||!e.changedTouches.length)return;const dy=e.changedTouches[0].clientY-sheetY,dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-sheetX;sheetY=null;if(Math.abs(dy)<40||Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*.8)return;if(dy<0)toggleSheet(true);else if(detail.scrollTop<=3)toggleSheet(false);},{passive:true});
function mapSel(o){if(o.unplaced)return null;const k=typ(o);return {n:o.name,cat:k==='road'?'R':k==='district'?'D':o.kind||({nature:'N',business:'B',civic:'C'}[k]||'L'),wx:Number(o.x)||0,wy:Number(o.y)||0,district:o.district||''}}
function focusPlace(o,force){const map=window.__nvmap;if(!map||!Number.isFinite(Number(o.x))||!Number.isFinite(Number(o.y)))return;const v=map.getView?map.getView():{z:.6};const desired=force?(typ(o)==='district'?.92:typ(o)==='road'?1.1:1.5):Math.max(v.z,typ(o)==='district'?.75:1.10);map.setView(+o.x,+o.y,Math.min(3.1,desired),false)}
function choose(o,focus){if(!o)return;const s=mapSel(o);if(window.__nvmap)window.__nvmap.select(s);renderDetail(o);if(focus&&!o.unplaced)focusPlace(o,false);if(innerWidth<=760)toggleGuide(false)}
function closeDetails(){detail.classList.remove('nv-expanded','nv-open');detail.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');document.body.classList.remove('nv-selected');selected=null;if(window.__nvmap)window.__nvmap.select(null);renderList()}
function onMapSelect(s){if(!s){closeDetails();return}let o=object(s.n);if(!o){const t={R:'road',D:'district',N:'N',C:'C',B:'B',L:'L'}[s.cat]||'L';o={name:s.n,kind:t,x:s.wx,y:s.wy,type:s.cat==='D'?'Mapped area':'Mapped location',episodes:[],aliases:[]}}renderDetail(o);if(innerWidth<=760)toggleGuide(false)}
window.NV_UI={onMapSelect,chooseName:n=>choose(object(n),true),closeDetails};
function init(){if(!window.NV_META||!window.NV_DATA){setTimeout(init,70);return}meta=window.NV_META;window.NV_CATEGORY=category;document.body.dataset.nvTheme=document.body.dataset.nvTheme||'vale';all=[...Object.values(meta.places||{}),...Object.values(meta.roads||{}),...Object.values(meta.districts||{})].filter(o=>o&&o.name);foot.textContent=window.NV_DATA.I.length+' plotted records · '+all.length+' searchable entries';renderList();toggleGuide(innerWidth>760)}
search.addEventListener('input',()=>{query=search.value;limit=90;renderList()});
list.addEventListener('click',e=>{const btn=e.target.closest('button[data-name],button[data-more]');if(!btn)return;if(btn.dataset.more){limit+=90;renderList();return}choose(object(btn.dataset.name),true)});
document.querySelectorAll('#nv-fieldguide .nv-filter').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{category=b.dataset.filter;limit=90;document.querySelectorAll('#nv-fieldguide .nv-filter').forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(x===b)));window.NV_CATEGORY=category;if(window.__nvmap)window.__nvmap.set({category});renderList()}));
document.getElementById('nv-hide-guide').onclick=()=>toggleGuide(false);showGuide.onclick=()=>toggleGuide(true);
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){if(detail.classList.contains('nv-open'))closeDetails();else if(open&&innerWidth<=760)toggleGuide(false)}if((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='k'){e.preventDefault();toggleGuide(true);search.focus()}});
init();
})();
};
</script>

<style>html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#e1cea5}a{color:#7a4a32}a:hover{color:var(--pfg)}</style>
</helmet>

<style id="nv-mobile-selection-v9">
/* The phone card is a true two-state bottom sheet, not a full-size sidebar. */
.nv-sheet-toggle{display:none}
.nv-more-content{display:block}
@media(max-width:760px){
  #nv-details{top:auto!important;left:12px!important;right:12px!important;bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 82px)!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overscroll-behavior:contain;border-radius:17px;padding:11px 17px 14px!important;box-shadow:0 13px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.37);transition:transform .2s ease,opacity .2s ease,visibility .2s ease;scrollbar-width:thin}
  #nv-details.nv-open:not(.nv-expanded){max-height:148px!important;overflow:hidden!important}
  #nv-details .nv-sheet-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;width:100%;min-height:24px;padding:0 0 6px;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--nv-muted);font:600 10px var(--nv-body-font);letter-spacing:.035em;cursor:pointer;touch-action:pan-y}
  .nv-sheet-grip{display:inline-block;flex:0 0 30px;width:30px;height:4px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--nv-accent);opacity:.8}
  .nv-sheet-chevron{font-size:17px;color:var(--nv-accent);line-height:1;transition:transform .2s}
  #nv-details.nv-expanded .nv-sheet-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg)}
  #nv-details .nv-detail-top{align-items:center;margin-top:2px}
  #nv-details .nv-detail-kind{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.09em;padding-top:0}
  #nv-details h2,body[data-nv-theme="vale"] #nv-details h2{font-size:clamp(22px,6vw,29px)!important;line-height:1.05;margin:3px 0 4px;letter-spacing:.01em}
  #nv-details .nv-detail-sub{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  #nv-details .nv-more-content{display:none}
  #nv-details.nv-expanded .nv-more-content{display:block;margin-top:13px;padding-bottom:2px}
  #nv-details.nv-expanded{max-height:calc(100dvh - 92px)!important;overflow-y:auto!important;padding-bottom:18px!important}
  #nv-details .nv-iconbtn{min-width:30px;min-height:28px;padding:5px;font-size:17px}
  /* The closed sheet shows just the destination name and drag affordance. */
  #nv-details.nv-open:not(.nv-expanded){padding:7px 16px 10px!important;max-height:88px!important}
  #nv-details:not(.nv-expanded) .nv-sheet-toggle{min-height:18px;height:18px;padding:0 0 2px;gap:7px;font-size:9px}
  #nv-details:not(.nv-expanded) .nv-detail-top{height:0;min-height:0;margin:0;position:static}
  #nv-details:not(.nv-expanded) .nv-detail-kind,#nv-details:not(.nv-expanded) .nv-detail-sub{display:none}
  #nv-details:not(.nv-expanded) .nv-detail-top .nv-iconbtn{position:absolute;right:11px;top:31px;z-index:2}
  #nv-details:not(.nv-expanded) h2{margin:3px 32px 3px 0!important;line-height:1.04;font-size:clamp(21px,5.9vw,27px)!important}

  /* All top controls share one baseline and fixed tap height. */
  #nv-show-guide{left:12px!important;top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;bottom:auto!important;min-height:38px;height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 11px!important;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
  #nv-show-guide[hidden]{display:none!important}
  .nv-map-tools{position:absolute!important;right:12px!important;top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;left:auto!important;gap:5px!important}
  .nv-map-tools>div:first-child{align-items:center;gap:6px!important}
  .nv-map-tools>div:first-child>button{height:38px!important;min-height:38px;border-radius:12px!important;padding:0 10px!important;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1}
  .nv-map-tools>div:first-child>button span{flex-shrink:0}
  #nv-fieldguide{top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top))!important;left:12px!important;width:min(340px,calc(100vw - 24px))!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px - env(safe-area-inset-top))!important}
  .nv-zoom-tools{right:12px!important;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))!important}
  body.nv-selected .nv-map-tools{right:12px!important;opacity:1!important;pointer-events:auto!important}
  body.nv-selected .nv-zoom-tools{opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none!important}
}
@media(max-width:390px){
  #nv-show-guide{padding:0 8px!important;font-size:11px}
  .nv-map-tools>div:first-child>button{padding:0 8px!important;font-size:11px!important;gap:5px!important}
  .nv-map-tools>div:first-child>button>span:first-child{transform:scale(.85)}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#nv-details,.nv-sheet-chevron{transition:none!important}}
</style>

<style>/* Floating research interface: overlay only, illustrated map remains untouched. */
:root{--nv-paper:rgba(253,247,235,.975);--nv-ink:#3d2e28;--nv-muted:#79685a;--nv-rule:rgba(83,59,38,.16);--nv-accent:#a35333}
#nv-fieldguide,#nv-details,#nv-show-guide{font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--nv-ink);box-sizing:border-box;}
#nv-fieldguide *,#nv-details *{box-sizing:border-box}
#nv-fieldguide{position:fixed;z-index:56;left:2rem;top:2rem;width:min(342px,calc(100vw - 4rem));height:calc(100dvh - 4rem);max-height:800px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:19px;background:var(--nv-paper);border:1px solid rgba(78,55,37,.23);box-shadow:0 18px 58px rgba(57,39,20,.22),0 3px 9px rgba(57,39,20,.1);overflow:hidden;transition:transform .23s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1),opacity .18s}
#nv-fieldguide.nv-closed{transform:translateX(calc(-100% - 3rem));opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.nv-mast{padding:24px 22px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--nv-rule);flex:none;position:relative}
.nv-eyebrow{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:700;color:var(--nv-accent)}
.nv-headline{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-size:39px;font-weight:700;line-height:.88;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:10px 0 11px}
.nv-lede{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--nv-muted);margin:0 0 13px;max-width:270px}
.nv-iconbtn{background:transparent;border:0;color:#75614f;cursor:pointer;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:30px;min-height:30px}
.nv-iconbtn:hover{background:rgba(83,59,38,.085);color:#3d2e28}
.nv-hide-btn{position:absolute;right:14px;top:15px}
#nv-search{display:block;width:100%;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(88,65,44,.22);border-radius:10px;padding:0 12px 0 35px;color:#3d2e28;background:#fffdf7;font:400 13px 'Jost',sans-serif;outline:0}
#nv-search:focus{border-color:#a45f3b;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(164,95,59,.13)}
.nv-search-wrap{position:relative}.nv-search-glyph{position:absolute;top:11px;left:12px;font-size:16px;color:#907863;pointer-events:none}
.nv-filter-row{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:12px 19px 11px;flex:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--nv-rule);scrollbar-width:none}.nv-filter-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nv-filter{white-space:nowrap;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #d5c3aa;background:#faf2e5;color:#75614e;font:600 11px 'Jost',sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.nv-filter:hover{border-color:#ad6d47}.nv-filter[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#4a3328;border-color:#4a3328;color:#fff7ea}
.nv-list-top{padding:11px 22px 7px;font:600 10px 'Jost',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9b7a63;flex:none}
#nv-place-list{overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;flex:1;min-height:0;padding:0 11px 16px 15px;scrollbar-color:#c7ad94 transparent;scrollbar-width:thin}
.nv-result{width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:left;border-radius:11px;padding:9px 9px;cursor:pointer;color:#3d2e28;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;min-height:50px}.nv-result:hover{background:rgba(168,117,68,.12)}.nv-result[aria-current="true"]{background:#eee0cd;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 #a45c37}
.nv-result-icon{width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(156,118,76,.13);font-size:16px;color:#806046}.nv-result-name{font-weight:600;font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.22}.nv-result-sub{font-size:10.7px;color:#8c7866;line-height:1.35;margin-top:3px}.nv-result-text{min-width:0;flex:1}
.nv-list-footer{padding:11px 20px;font:500 10.5px 'Jost',sans-serif;color:#927a65;border-top:1px solid var(--nv-rule);background:rgba(245,234,215,.55);flex:none}
#nv-show-guide{position:fixed;z-index:56;left:2rem;top:2rem;border:1px solid rgba(83,59,38,.25);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(250,242,226,.97);color:#4a3328;font:700 12px 'Jost',sans-serif;padding:11px 16px;box-shadow:0 5px 17px #32201238;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .16s,transform .2s}
#nv-show-guide[hidden]{display:none}#nv-show-guide:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:#fff8eb}
#nv-details{position:fixed;z-index:70;right:2rem;top:2rem;bottom:auto;width:min(405px,calc(100vw - 4rem));height:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 4rem);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;border:1px solid rgba(78,55,37,.25);border-radius:19px;background:var(--nv-paper);padding:23px 24px 24px;box-shadow:0 20px 64px rgba(42,27,11,.25),0 4px 12px rgba(42,27,11,.13);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(22px);transition:opacity .22s,transform .24s,visibility .24s;scrollbar-color:#c7ad94 transparent;scrollbar-width:thin}
#nv-details.nv-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateX(0)}
.nv-detail-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;position:relative}.nv-detail-kind{font-size:10px;color:var(--nv-accent);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;padding-top:4px}
#nv-details h2{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-size:34px;line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:9px 0 11px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#3b2c25}
.nv-detail-sub{font:500 12px 'Jost',sans-serif;color:#8d745f;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.5}
.nv-detail-note{font:400 13px/1.55 'Jost',sans-serif;color:#4c3c31;margin:12px 0}
.nv-section{border-top:1px solid var(--nv-rule);margin-top:18px;padding-top:14px}.nv-section h3{font:700 10px 'Jost',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#a35430;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 10px}
.nv-tag-list{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.nv-ep-tag{font:600 10.5px 'Jost',sans-serif;color:#77583f;background:#f2e5d2;border:1px solid #e2cfb5;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px}
.nv-relation{font:400 12px/1.5 'Jost',sans-serif;color:#624c3b;margin:6px 0}.nv-relation b{color:#3e3029}
.nv-source{border-radius:11px;background:#f3e9da;border:1px solid #e7d8c5;padding:12px 14px;margin:9px 0}.nv-source small{display:block;font:700 10px 'Jost',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#9a603f;margin-bottom:5px}.nv-source p{font:italic 600 16px/1.24 'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;color:#493528;margin:0}
.nv-detail-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:19px}.nv-action{border:1px solid #ae8669;border-radius:9px;background:#4d372c;color:#fff9eb;font:600 12px 'Jost',sans-serif;padding:10px 13px;cursor:pointer}.nv-action:hover{background:#614539}.nv-action.alt{background:transparent;color:#654936;border-color:#d6c1a8}.nv-action.alt:hover{background:#f1e2ce}
.nv-link{display:inline-block;color:#8a4d32;font:600 12px 'Jost',sans-serif;text-decoration:none;margin-top:10px}.nv-link:hover{text-decoration:underline}
body[data-nv-theme="night"]{--nv-paper:rgba(35,32,48,.975);--nv-ink:#eee4d7;--nv-muted:#b6a7a9;--nv-rule:rgba(235,218,202,.16);--nv-accent:#e5b48a}
body[data-nv-theme="night"] #nv-fieldguide,body[data-nv-theme="night"] #nv-details{border-color:#655466}
body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-headline,body[data-nv-theme="night"] #nv-details h2,body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-result,body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-detail-note,body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-detail-sub{color:#f3e8dc}
body[data-nv-theme="night"] #nv-search{background:#29283a;color:#f4ecdd;border-color:#69556b}
body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-filter{background:#322d45;border-color:#685a6d;color:#dbcce2}body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-filter[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#a96d50;color:white}
body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-result:hover,body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-result[aria-current="true"]{background:rgba(216,161,124,.17)}body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-list-footer{background:rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-source{background:#363045;border-color:#5a485a}body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-source p{color:#f0dfce}
body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-ep-tag{background:#4a3c4b;border-color:#675268;color:#f0d4b8}body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-action.alt{color:#eee4d7}
@media(max-width:1050px){#nv-fieldguide{width:300px}#nv-details{width:min(345px,calc(100vw - 4rem))}}
@media(max-width:760px){#nv-fieldguide{left:1rem;top:1rem;width:min(340px,calc(100vw - 2rem));height:min(74dvh,720px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 2rem)}#nv-show-guide{left:1rem;top:1rem}#nv-details{top:auto;bottom:1rem;left:1rem;right:1rem;width:auto;max-height:min(70dvh,calc(100dvh - 2rem));padding:19px 20px 23px;transform:translateY(25px)}#nv-details.nv-open{transform:translateY(0)}#nv-details h2{font-size:31px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#nv-fieldguide,#nv-details,#nv-show-guide{transition:none}}
/* Allow the field guide to shrink after searches, while keeping a tall scrollable list for all places. */
#nv-fieldguide{height:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 4rem)}
#nv-place-list{flex:0 1 auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 350px)}
@media(max-width:760px){#nv-fieldguide{height:auto;max-height:min(74dvh,calc(100dvh - 2rem))}#nv-place-list{max-height:calc(74dvh - 300px)}}
</style>

<style id="nv-themed-guide">
/* Only use the proprietary title font when the visitor has installed a licensed copy. */
@font-face{font-family:'NV Big Noodle Local';src:local('Big Noodle Titling'),local('BigNoodleTitling');font-display:swap}
body{--nv-title-font:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;--nv-body-font:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif;--nv-hover-bg:rgba(252,246,232,.98);--nv-select:#a15b35;--nv-field:#fffaf0;--nv-pill:#f7ebd9;--nv-pill-ink:#7a614c;--nv-source-bg:#f5ebdd;--nv-title-weight:700}
body[data-nv-theme="vale"]{--nv-paper:rgba(19,9,29,.965);--nv-ink:#f6edff;--nv-muted:#bba9c9;--nv-rule:rgba(212,182,240,.21);--nv-accent:#d2a4fa;--nv-field:#251530;--nv-pill:#30203d;--nv-pill-ink:#e0c6f2;--nv-select:#bd84f2;--nv-source-bg:#251731;--nv-hover-bg:rgba(24,12,35,.97);--nv-title-font:'NV Big Noodle Local','Bebas Neue','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--nv-body-font:'Space Grotesk','Jost',sans-serif;--nv-title-weight:400}
body[data-nv-theme="desert"]{--nv-paper:rgba(251,242,222,.965);--nv-ink:#3b2921;--nv-muted:#816b54;--nv-rule:rgba(98,66,37,.23);--nv-accent:#9b522e;--nv-field:#fff8e9;--nv-pill:#f1e4cb;--nv-pill-ink:#715138;--nv-select:#9d542d;--nv-source-bg:#f1e4cf;--nv-hover-bg:rgba(251,243,224,.98);--nv-title-font:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;--nv-body-font:'Jost',sans-serif}
body[data-nv-theme="modern"]{--nv-paper:rgba(255,255,254,.96);--nv-ink:#2f3335;--nv-muted:#747779;--nv-rule:rgba(51,56,58,.16);--nv-accent:#9e6e35;--nv-field:#f9f9f7;--nv-pill:#f1f0ea;--nv-pill-ink:#545859;--nv-select:#ae7334;--nv-source-bg:#f4f2eb;--nv-hover-bg:rgba(255,255,254,.98);--nv-title-font:'Bebas Neue','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--nv-body-font:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;--nv-title-weight:400}
body[data-nv-theme="slate"]{--nv-paper:rgba(40,60,59,.97);--nv-ink:#eaf6f2;--nv-muted:#b9ceca;--nv-rule:rgba(205,232,224,.22);--nv-accent:#a9e4c6;--nv-field:#334e4b;--nv-pill:#385a56;--nv-pill-ink:#d2eee6;--nv-select:#9bdfc0;--nv-source-bg:#334d4a;--nv-hover-bg:rgba(36,55,53,.98);--nv-title-font:'Bebas Neue','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--nv-body-font:'Jost',sans-serif;--nv-title-weight:400}
body[data-nv-theme="frost"]{--nv-paper:rgba(243,248,254,.97);--nv-ink:#283c56;--nv-muted:#6e8299;--nv-rule:rgba(62,97,137,.18);--nv-accent:#356f9e;--nv-field:#ffffff;--nv-pill:#e6eff8;--nv-pill-ink:#4e6884;--nv-select:#357ba8;--nv-source-bg:#e6f0f8;--nv-hover-bg:rgba(244,249,255,.98);--nv-title-font:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;--nv-body-font:'Jost',sans-serif}
body[data-nv-theme="parchment"]{--nv-paper:rgba(236,225,200,.97);--nv-ink:#48352a;--nv-muted:#78614f;--nv-rule:rgba(103,76,49,.22);--nv-accent:#8f5031;--nv-field:#f7ebd4;--nv-pill:#e5d0af;--nv-pill-ink:#644a35;--nv-select:#925739;--nv-source-bg:#e5d4b6;--nv-hover-bg:rgba(237,225,202,.98);--nv-title-font:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;--nv-body-font:'Jost',sans-serif}
body[data-nv-theme="night"]{--nv-paper:rgba(32,34,55,.97);--nv-ink:#fff3df;--nv-muted:#b7b9d0;--nv-rule:rgba(236,222,197,.18);--nv-accent:#f5d08d;--nv-field:#30334f;--nv-pill:#353a59;--nv-pill-ink:#eee3ca;--nv-select:#f2c675;--nv-source-bg:#333750;--nv-hover-bg:rgba(32,34,55,.98);--nv-title-font:'Bebas Neue','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--nv-body-font:'Jost',sans-serif;--nv-title-weight:400}
#nv-fieldguide,#nv-details,#nv-show-guide{font-family:var(--nv-body-font);color:var(--nv-ink);background:var(--nv-paper);border-color:var(--nv-rule)}
#nv-fieldguide,#nv-details{box-shadow:0 19px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.23),0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.nv-mast{padding:22px 22px 16px}
.nv-headline{font-family:var(--nv-title-font);font-size:39px;line-height:1;font-weight:var(--nv-title-weight);letter-spacing:.035em;color:var(--nv-ink);margin:2px 0 9px;text-transform:uppercase}
body[data-nv-theme="desert"] .nv-headline,body[data-nv-theme="parchment"] .nv-headline,body[data-nv-theme="frost"] .nv-headline{font-size:35px;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
.nv-lede,.nv-result-sub,.nv-detail-sub,.nv-list-footer,.nv-list-top{color:var(--nv-muted)}
.nv-iconbtn{color:var(--nv-muted)}.nv-iconbtn:hover{background:var(--nv-pill);color:var(--nv-ink)}
#nv-search{font-family:var(--nv-body-font);background:var(--nv-field);color:var(--nv-ink);border-color:var(--nv-rule)}
#nv-search::placeholder{color:var(--nv-muted)}#nv-search:focus{border-color:var(--nv-accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--nv-accent) 18%,transparent)}
.nv-search-glyph{color:var(--nv-muted)}
.nv-filter{font-family:var(--nv-body-font);background:var(--nv-pill);border-color:var(--nv-rule);color:var(--nv-pill-ink);transition:background .15s,transform .15s,border-color .15s}
.nv-filter:hover{border-color:var(--nv-accent);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.nv-filter[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--nv-select);border-color:var(--nv-select);color:var(--nv-paper);filter:brightness(1.05)}
body[data-nv-theme="vale"] .nv-filter[aria-pressed="true"],body[data-nv-theme="slate"] .nv-filter[aria-pressed="true"],body[data-nv-theme="night"] .nv-filter[aria-pressed="true"]{color:#180e23}
.nv-result{font-family:var(--nv-body-font);color:var(--nv-ink)}.nv-result:hover,.nv-result[aria-current="true"]{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--nv-select) 17%,transparent)}.nv-result[aria-current="true"]{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--nv-accent)}
.nv-result-icon{background:var(--nv-pill);color:var(--nv-accent)}
.nv-result-sub,.nv-result-name{color:inherit}.nv-result-sub{opacity:.68}
.nv-list-footer{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--nv-pill) 44%,transparent)}
#nv-show-guide{font-family:var(--nv-body-font);color:var(--nv-ink);border-color:var(--nv-rule)}#nv-show-guide:hover{background:var(--nv-pill)}
.nv-detail-kind,.nv-section h3{color:var(--nv-accent);font-family:var(--nv-body-font)}
#nv-details h2{font-family:var(--nv-title-font);font-weight:var(--nv-title-weight);letter-spacing:.025em;color:var(--nv-ink)}
body[data-nv-theme="vale"] #nv-details h2{font-size:39px}
.nv-detail-note,.nv-relation,.nv-relation b{font-family:var(--nv-body-font);color:var(--nv-ink)}.nv-detail-sub{font-family:var(--nv-body-font);color:var(--nv-muted)}
.nv-ep-tag{background:var(--nv-pill);border-color:var(--nv-rule);color:var(--nv-pill-ink);font-family:var(--nv-body-font)}
.nv-source{background:var(--nv-source-bg);border-color:var(--nv-rule)}.nv-source p{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;color:var(--nv-ink)}.nv-source small{color:var(--nv-accent);font-family:var(--nv-body-font)}
.nv-action{background:var(--nv-select);color:var(--nv-paper);border-color:var(--nv-select);font-family:var(--nv-body-font)}.nv-action:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);background:var(--nv-select)}
.nv-action.alt{background:transparent;color:var(--nv-ink);border-color:var(--nv-rule)}.nv-action.alt:hover{background:var(--nv-pill)}.nv-link{color:var(--nv-accent)}
#nv-fieldguide{top:2rem;left:2rem;bottom:auto;height:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 4rem);width:min(342px,calc(100vw - 4rem))}
#nv-place-list{max-height:calc(100dvh - 325px);min-height:0}
#nv-details{top:2rem;right:2rem;bottom:auto;height:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 4rem);overflow-y:auto}
/* Interactive map toolbars move into the central map area when the detail panel is open. */
.nv-map-tools,.nv-zoom-tools{transition:right .2s ease}
@media(min-width:1061px){body.nv-selected .nv-map-tools,body.nv-selected .nv-zoom-tools{right:calc(2rem + 425px)!important}}
@media(min-width:761px) and (max-width:1060px){body.nv-selected .nv-map-tools,body.nv-selected .nv-zoom-tools{right:calc(2rem + 360px)!important}}
@media(max-width:760px){#nv-fieldguide{left:1rem;top:1rem;width:min(340px,calc(100vw - 2rem));max-height:calc(100dvh - 2rem)}#nv-details{top:auto;left:1rem;right:1rem;bottom:1rem;max-height:calc(72dvh - 1rem)}#nv-place-list{max-height:calc(74dvh - 255px)}body.nv-selected .nv-zoom-tools{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}}
/* Contextual hover previews; the map's marker animation stays native. */
.nv-hover-card{position:absolute;z-index:21;pointer-events:none;max-width:min(310px,calc(100vw - 28px));width:max-content;min-width:168px;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:13px;background:var(--nv-hover-bg);border:1px solid var(--nv-rule);color:var(--nv-ink);box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.27);white-space:normal;line-height:1.3;opacity:0;transition:opacity .14s}
.nv-hover-kicker{font:700 10px var(--nv-body-font);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nv-accent)}
.nv-hover-name{font:400 24px/1.05 var(--nv-title-font);margin:6px 0 7px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.nv-hover-excerpt{font:italic 600 15px/1.28 'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;color:var(--nv-muted)}
.nv-hover-hint{font:700 10px var(--nv-body-font);letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--nv-accent);margin-top:9px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.nv-map-tools,.nv-zoom-tools,.nv-hover-card{transition:none}}
</style>
<div style="position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:{{ bg }};font-family:var(--fu);--pbg:{{ pbg }};--pbtn:{{ pbtn }};--pfg:{{ pfg }};--pfg2:{{ pfg2 }};--pfg3:{{ pfg3 }};--pline:{{ pline }};--phov:{{ phov }};--psh:{{ psh }};--pacc:{{ pacc }};--paccs:{{ paccs }};--fu:{{ fu }};--fd:{{ fd }}">
  <div ref="{{ hostRef }}" style="position:absolute;inset:0"></div>
  <sc-if value="{{ loading }}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ true }}">
    <div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none">
      <div style="font-family:var(--fd);font-style:italic;font-size:22px;color:var(--pfg3)">Surveying the town…</div>
    </div>
  </sc-if>
  <div class="nv-map-tools" style="position:absolute;right:2rem;top:2rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px">
  <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center">
  <button sc-camel-on-click="{{ toggleStyleMenu }}" aria-expanded="{{ styleOpen }}" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:38px;padding:0 14px 0 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--pline);background:var(--pbtn);color:var(--pfg);font:600 13px var(--fu);letter-spacing:.04em;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px var(--psh)">
    <span style="width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--pline);background:{{ curSwatch }}"></span>
    <span>{{ curStyleLabel }}</span>
    <span style="font-size:10px;opacity:.6">▾</span>
  </button>
  <button sc-camel-on-click="{{ toggleDistricts }}" aria-pressed="{{ districtsOn }}" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:38px;padding:0 14px 0 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--pline);background:{{ dBg }};color:{{ dFg }};font:600 13px var(--fu);letter-spacing:.04em;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px var(--psh)">
    <span style="width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;border:2px dashed {{ dFg }}"></span>
    <span>Districts</span>
  </button>
  </div>
  <sc-if value="{{ styleOpen }}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ false }}">
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:6px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--pbg);border:1px solid var(--pline);box-shadow:0 10px 28px var(--psh);min-width:170px">
      <sc-for list="{{ styleList }}" as="st" hint-placeholder-count="6">
        <button sc-camel-on-click="{{ st.pick }}" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:36px;padding:0 10px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:{{ st.bg }};color:var(--pfg);font:500 13.5px var(--fu);cursor:pointer;text-align:left" style-hover="background:var(--phov)">
          <span style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--pline);background:{{ st.swatch }}"></span>
          <span>{{ st.label }}</span>
        </button>
      </sc-for>
    </div>
  </sc-if>
  </div>
  <div class="nv-zoom-tools" style="position:absolute;right:2rem;bottom:2rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pbtn);border:1px solid var(--pline);box-shadow:0 4px 14px var(--psh)">
    <button sc-camel-on-click="{{ zoomIn }}" aria-label="Zoom in" style="width:40px;height:40px;border:0;background:transparent;font:500 22px var(--fu);color:var(--pfg);cursor:pointer" style-hover="background:var(--phov)">+</button>
    <button sc-camel-on-click="{{ zoomOut }}" aria-label="Zoom out" style="width:40px;height:40px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--pline);background:transparent;font:500 22px var(--fu);color:var(--pfg);cursor:pointer" style-hover="background:var(--phov)">−</button>
    <button sc-camel-on-click="{{ fit }}" aria-label="Show the whole town" style="width:40px;height:40px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--pline);background:transparent;font:500 15px var(--fu);color:var(--pfg);cursor:pointer" style-hover="background:var(--phov)">⤢</button>
  </div>
</div>
</x-dc>
<aside id="nv-fieldguide" aria-label="Night Vale location guide">
 <header class="nv-mast">
  <button id="nv-hide-guide" class="nv-iconbtn nv-hide-btn" type="button" aria-label="Hide place guide" title="Hide places">‹</button>
  <h1 class="nv-headline">NIGHT VALE</h1>
  <p class="nv-lede">Explore the places, roads and mysteries mentioned on the air.</p>
  <div class="nv-search-wrap"><span class="nv-search-glyph">⌕</span><input id="nv-search" type="search" placeholder="Search places, streets, episodes…" aria-label="Search Night Vale places" autocomplete="off"></div>
 </header>
 <div class="nv-filter-row" role="group" aria-label="Location categories">
  <button class="nv-filter" data-filter="all" aria-pressed="true">All</button><button class="nv-filter" data-filter="landmark" aria-pressed="false">Landmarks</button><button class="nv-filter" data-filter="business" aria-pressed="false">Businesses</button><button class="nv-filter" data-filter="civic" aria-pressed="false">Civic</button><button class="nv-filter" data-filter="nature" aria-pressed="false">Nature</button><button class="nv-filter" data-filter="road" aria-pressed="false">Streets</button><button class="nv-filter" data-filter="district" aria-pressed="false">Districts</button>
 </div>
 <div class="nv-list-top" id="nv-results-count">Loading places…</div>
 <nav id="nv-place-list" aria-label="Search results"></nav>
 <footer class="nv-list-footer" id="nv-guide-footer">Illustrated transcript atlas</footer>
</aside>
<button id="nv-show-guide" type="button" hidden="" aria-expanded="true">☷ &nbsp; Places</button>
<aside id="nv-details" role="region" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Selected place details" aria-hidden="true"></aside>

<script type="text/x-dc" data-dc-script="" data-props="{&quot;style&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;enum&quot;,&quot;options&quot;:[&quot;desert&quot;,&quot;vale&quot;,&quot;modern&quot;,&quot;slate&quot;,&quot;frost&quot;,&quot;parchment&quot;,&quot;night&quot;],&quot;default&quot;:&quot;vale&quot;,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;'desert'|'vale'|'modern'|'slate'|'frost'|'parchment'|'night'&quot;},&quot;districts&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;default&quot;:false,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;},&quot;labels&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;default&quot;:true,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;},&quot;streetNames&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;default&quot;:true,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;}}">
const UI = {
  desert: ['#e1cea5', '#3a2c26', 'rgba(246,238,222,.95)'],
  night: ['#2c2d4a', '#f1ead9', 'rgba(28,26,48,.9)'],
  slate: ['#7c8d8b', '#182021', 'rgba(190,203,200,.92)'],
  frost: ['#e3e9f1', '#2b3a56', 'rgba(246,248,252,.95)'],
  parchment: ['#e2d5bd', '#4a3426', 'rgba(240,232,216,.95)'],
  modern: ['#efebe2', '#4b4a47', 'rgba(255,255,255,.95)'],
  vale: ['#120919', '#f3e9f8', 'rgba(9,1,13,.9)']
};
const LABELS = { vale: 'Night Vale', desert: 'Desert', modern: 'Modern', slate: 'Slate', frost: 'Frost', parchment: 'Parchment', night: 'Night' };
const SW = { vale: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#09010d 50%,#8b4ca7 50%)', desert: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#e7d4ae 50%,#e8b562 50%)', modern: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#f7f5f0 50%,#f9d27a 50%)', slate: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#7c8d8b 50%,#cbd5d2 50%)', frost: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#e3e9f1 50%,#9fb6d6 50%)', parchment: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#e2d5bd 50%,#a07a52 50%)', night: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#2c2d4a 50%,#ffd98a 50%)' };
class Component extends DCLogic {
  state = { loading: true, districts: null };
  districtsOn() { return this.state.districts ?? (this.props.districts ?? false); }
  hostRef = React.createRef();
  styleName() { const s = this.state.style ?? this.props.style ?? 'vale'; return UI[s] ? s : 'vale'; }
  opts() { const s = this.styleName(); return { style: s, night: s === 'night', labels: this.props.labels ?? true, streets: this.props.streetNames ?? true, districts: this.districtsOn(), category: window.NV_CATEGORY || 'all' }; }
  componentDidMount() {
    const go = () => {
      if (!window.NV_BOOT || !window.NV_DATA || !window.NV_META || !(window.NV_FIXES && window.NV_FIXES.length >= 6) || !this.hostRef.current) { this.t = setTimeout(go, 60); return; }
      if (!window.NV_DATA._booted) { window.NV_DATA._booted = 1; for (const fn of window.NV_FIXES) fn(); }
      else if (window.NV_META && window.NV_META.places && !window.NV_META.places['Susie Q’s']) { window.NV_FIXES.slice(3).forEach(fn => fn()); }
      window.NV_BOOT();
      if (document.fonts) Promise.all(["400 20px 'Bebas Neue'", "500 14px 'Space Grotesk'", "700 14px 'Space Grotesk'"].map(f => document.fonts.load(f).catch(() => {}))).then(() => { if (this.map) this.map.set({}); });
      this.map = window.NVMap.create(this.hostRef.current, { ...this.opts(), onReady: () => this.setState({ loading: false }), onSelect: (s) => { this.setState({ sel: s }); if (window.NV_UI) window.NV_UI.onMapSelect(s); } });
    };
    go();
  }
  componentDidUpdate() { document.body.dataset.nvTheme=this.styleName(); if (this.map) this.map.set(this.opts()); }
  componentWillUnmount() { clearTimeout(this.t); if (this.map) this.map.destroy(); }
  selVals() {
    const s = this.state.sel;
    if (!s) return { hasSel: false, selName: '', selKind: '', selDistrict: '', selEp: '', selEps: '', selAka: '', selStatus: '', selNote: '', selQuote: '', selQuoteSrc: '' };
    const M = window.NV_META || {}, m = (M.places && M.places[s.n]) || (M.roads && M.roads[s.n]) || null;
    const KIND = { L: 'Landmark', B: 'Business', C: 'Civic', N: 'Natural feature', R: 'Street' };
    const kind = (m && m.type) ? m.type : (KIND[s.cat] || (s.cat ? String(s.cat) : 'Place'));
    const ep = m && (m.first || (m.episodes && m.episodes[0]));
    const eps = m && m.episodes && m.episodes.length > 1 ? 'Episodes ' + m.episodes.slice(0, 8).join(', ') + (m.episodes.length > 8 ? '…' : '') : '';
    const aka = m && m.aliases && m.aliases.length ? 'Also called ' + m.aliases.slice(0, 3).join(', ') : '';
    const stl = m && m.status ? String(m.status) : '';
    const status = /unsourced/i.test(stl) ? 'No transcript source found' : /infer|schematic/i.test(stl) ? 'Inferred placement' : '';
    const x = m && m.excerpt && m.excerpt[0];
    let q = x && x.text ? x.text.trim() : '';
    if (q.length > 220) q = q.slice(0, 220).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…';
    const dist = s.cat === 'D' ? '' : (s.district || (m && m.district) || '');
    return { hasSel: true, selName: s.n, selKind: s.cat === 'D' ? 'District' : kind, selDistrict: dist, selEp: ep ? 'First mentioned in Episode ' + ep : '', selEps: eps, selAka: aka, selStatus: status, selNote: (m && m.note) || '', selQuote: q ? '“…' + q + '”' : '', selQuoteSrc: x ? 'Ep. ' + x.episode + (x.title ? ' · ' + x.title : '') : '' };
  }
  theme() { const v = this.styleName() === 'vale', n = this.styleName() === 'night'; const dk = v || n; return { pbg: v ? 'rgba(20,10,28,.96)' : n ? 'rgba(28,26,48,.95)' : 'rgba(250,244,232,.97)', pbtn: v ? 'rgba(26,14,36,.94)' : n ? 'rgba(36,34,60,.94)' : 'rgba(246,238,222,.94)', pfg: dk ? '#f3e9f8' : '#3a2c26', pfg2: dk ? '#d9c6e6' : '#5a4638', pfg3: dk ? '#b49cc6' : '#7a6656', pline: dk ? 'rgba(243,233,248,.16)' : 'rgba(58,44,38,.22)', phov: dk ? 'rgba(243,233,248,.08)' : 'rgba(58,44,38,.07)', psh: dk ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)' : 'rgba(58,36,24,.16)', pacc: v ? '#c9a0ec' : n ? '#ffd98a' : '#a0532f', paccs: v ? 'rgba(185,138,224,.16)' : 'rgba(160,83,47,.1)', fu: v ? "'Space Grotesk',sans-serif" : "'Jost',sans-serif", fd: v ? "'Bebas Neue',sans-serif" : "'Cormorant Garamond',serif" }; }
  renderVals() {
    const u = UI[this.styleName()];
    return {
      hostRef: this.hostRef, loading: this.state.loading, bg: u[0], titleColor: u[1], titleHalo: u[2],
      districtsOn: this.districtsOn(), dBg: this.districtsOn() ? 'var(--pfg)' : 'var(--pbtn)', dFg: this.districtsOn() ? 'var(--pbtn)' : 'var(--pfg)', ...this.theme(),
      ...this.selVals(),
      styleOpen: !!this.state.styleOpen,
      toggleStyleMenu: () => this.setState({ styleOpen: !this.state.styleOpen }),
      curStyleLabel: LABELS[this.styleName()], curSwatch: SW[this.styleName()],
      styleList: Object.keys(UI).map(k => ({ label: LABELS[k], swatch: SW[k], bg: k === this.styleName() ? 'var(--phov)' : 'transparent', pick: () => this.setState({ style: k, styleOpen: false }) })),
      closeSel: () => { this.setState({ sel: null }); this.map && this.map.select(null); },
      toggleDistricts: () => this.setState({ districts: !this.districtsOn() }),
      zoomIn: () => this.map && this.map.zoomIn(), zoomOut: () => this.map && this.map.zoomOut(), fit: () => this.map && this.map.fit()
    };
  }
}
</script>


</body></html>
